text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text:
Alright, take your marks!
Ready......—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ……Gah, ah?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, late out of the gate again...!
Almond Eye had poor starts two mock races in a row, falling behind early. Even so—
choice_data_list: (She pulled off a solid win, as expected...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, geez...
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening...!
It was never like this before my debut.
True, she never seemed like the type to miss the break. Which means a change must have occurred after her Make Debut...
choice_data_list: (Because she's experienced the "real thing" or something?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The tension is amazing, and the spirit of the girls around me is on another level! I can feel how serious everyone is...!

I recall her speaking about it in high excitement.
Some Umamusume undergo a complete transformation when exposed to a totally different atmosphere.

Some girls are overcome by the intensity and grow afraid of racing.
Conversely, others get overly fired up with fighting spirit,
causing them to tense up even during regular training—
choice_data_list: (...Guess I should have a proper talk with her.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sho shweet~☆
I wuv the frappes here so much~♡
choice_data_list: So, why are you here too?
So, why are you here too?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because I wanna go out with Ai-chan, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's some for you too, Ai-chan!
It's almond-flavored and not too sweet♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But I'm sorry, I'm watching
my calorie intake right now.
Could you give it to Trainer instead?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm working out my body too, so...
Sorry, I'm watching my diet for training too...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Both of you are so stoic...!
Regaining my composure, I asked Almond Eye if she'd had any change of heart recently—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it, maybe I haven't been able to settle down this whole time?
choice_data_list: Restless... What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's like I can't think about anything other than the race.
Running has always filled my thoughts, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Even more passionate~?
Ai-chan wants to win a whole lot, after all."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Could that be the reason?
Because I want to win...?!"
choice_data_list: Even stronger than before?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so! Even after entering the gate,
I kept thinking about what I needed to do to win—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even during the last mock race,
it looked like she was doing mental training the entire time...!
choice_data_list: In other words, you were so eager to win that you missed the start... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oops! Even at the starting gate, 
all I can think about is my victory reward, you know?
choice_data_list: Maybe keeping it around that level is best for me right now.

text_block_list.text:
Rewards are a bit extreme, but... if you focus
solely on the start while in the gate,
wouldn't that fix the late starts?
choice_data_list: Let's wrap up the mental training early

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll keep that in mind during the next mock race!

And so, later on...
I set up another mock race. However—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ……Agh, not again~~……!!
choice_data_list: (That makes three late starts in a row...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer!
I... kind of overthought it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wondering "what do I need to do to win?"
...I just can't hold it back, no matter what!
choice_data_list: (I can't control it myself, huh...)

text_block_list.text: Almond Eye's desire for victory is formidable. Rather than leaving it entirely to her will, I want to devise training to heighten her awareness at the start.

First, to shorten her starting reaction time,
I decided to blow the whistle at irregular intervals
and have her react and dash immediately.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: (Yeah, her responses are gradually improving.)

text_block_list.text:
To further improve her focus,
I had her do some meditation.
She seems deeply locked in.
choice_data_list: (After this, we might just pull it off, right?)
(After this, we might just pull it off, don't you think?)

text_block_list.text: So, I decided to set up another mock race, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
...Aaaaahhh...!!
choice_data_list: Ai...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No! There's no way
I can just "not think about it"...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because—I want to win!!
choice_data_list: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.text:
Held by her steady gaze, sweat runs down my back.
An ordinary Umamusume could reset her mindset right away—
but for her, it's not so easy.
choice_data_list: (What a terrifying obsession with victory—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I swear I'll find a way!
Just give me a little more time...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to think about how to sort out
my thoughts on my own, too!
choice_data_list: Ah... In that case, I will too—
Ah... Then I'll too—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, just take over for a bit.
...I'm gonna go cool down.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan really is amazeballs.
Beyond stoic, she's an absolute demon about it~.
choice_data_list: ...Were you watching the whole time?
...Were you watching the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well, TBH, I'm pretty free right now.
I've been watching since this morning.
choice_data_list: There's something I've been wondering about for a while...

text_block_list.text:
"Why do you care about her so much?"
When asked that—
Fusaichi Pandora simply smiled.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Probably the same as you.
choice_data_list: Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan is just simply amazing, isn't she?
Being able to honestly want to win so purely like that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm kinda the type who can't do anything without a reward~
...Yeah, that's pretty much it."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yet Ai-chan has nothing like that.
Wanting praise, wanting recognition... none of it.
Just a pure, simple desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
To me, that looks...
exceptionally, brilliantly bright.

After muttering those words, Fusaichi Pandora fell silent,
as if completely entranced.
Ahead of her gaze stood Almond Eye.
choice_data_list: (......So bright and dazzling.)

text_block_list.text:
She is simply, dazzlingly radiant.
—So much so that it feels like she doesn't need any support at all.
choice_data_list: ...Ai, we're having a meeting when you get back!
...Ai, we'll have a meeting when you get back!

text_block_list.text:
Even so, I am her Trainer.
Then I'll hold on tightly, no matter what it takes, and keep supporting her.

Even the greatest Umamusume had a Trainer.
The day will surely come when you can lend her your strength at a critical moment—
choice_data_list: (I won't lose—to myself!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm ready anytime!
—Whistle, please, Trainer!
choice_data_list: (Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
That was way too sudden!
choice_data_list: If I stay properly focused, I can react to it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! I know, alright?! One more time!

And so, in order to overcome her slow starts,
she relentlessly continued training
to sharpen her focus at the gate—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'll be on my way.
choice_data_list: Ai, I'm sure you know this, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, that's enough mental training for now.
I've sorted out my feelings... I hope."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To win, I will suppress my 'desire to win.'
With that—it is all over!"

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text:
"On your mark!
Get set...—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Mmm...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How absolutely amazing this feels!
The breeze after a victory is truly something special!
choice_data_list: That start was perfect too!
That start was perfect too, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, why don't you scream too?
It'll make you feel so refreshed and good!
choice_data_list: No, I'm...
No, I...

text_block_list.text:
—I lacked the confidence that I had supported her enough
to shout out like that.
Of course, I kept those thoughts to myself...

More importantly... Because they wanted to win, they even held back their desire to win—
I wanted to know the secret behind that kind of strength.
choice_data_list: Hey, how can you push yourself that hard?
Hey, how can you push yourself that hard?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...?
What a strange thing to ask!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I can push through. I'll do whatever it takes to win!
After all, winning is the most fun thing in the world!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I told you about it before, right? Back at the junior club... how I kept trying and trying, and finally beat an opponent I never could before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy back then...
My heart was burning with passion the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —You must know it too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The fun of winning.
Come on, try to remember!
choice_data_list: Hmm, I haven't had an experience quite as intense as yours...
Hmm, I've never had an experience quite as intense as yours...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That couldn't be true.
Every single victory brings immense joy!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Because you hate losing—
just as much as I do."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You've worked hard to win, haven't you?
Honestly, anything is fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For example... when you study something
you didn't understand, and finally get it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Like, when you're playing a game...
and you finally beat your friend!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Like when I refused to lose at something no matter what—
and ended up winning against myself!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Anything is fine!
As long as I can recall those sparkling moments—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You must understand how I feel.
The joy of victory. That supreme, glorious sensation...!"
choice_data_list: Ai...

text_block_list.text:
—It slowly spreads throughout the heart.
Those moments of past victory... that pure joy.
A dazzling, overwhelming heat.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, now you understand, right?
If it's to experience that feeling—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even if I have to leave my body behind, I want to run.

Fulfillment, hope, joy... Hit directly by all of it,
an envy that shouldn't have even existed—
is dragged out into the open.
choice_data_list: (Next time, I'll get to taste it too... together with you)
(Next time, I'll get to taste it too... together with you)

text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I must gain the strength to stand alongside her...
and build the confidence to truly feel in my heart
that it is my victory, too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you just shout it out too?
There's nobody around, so now's your chance!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna win toooooo!!
I'm gonna win toooooo!!
I'm gonna work even harder than Ai----!!
I'm gonna support Ai all the way----!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you just shout it out too?
There's nobody around, so now's your chance!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna win toooooo!!
I'm gonna win toooooo!!
I'm gonna work even harder than Ai----!!
I'm gonna support Ai all the way----!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Sounds great!
Then I'll...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win even more, just you wait!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look who's talking.
Then I'll just have to...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll work way harder than any Trainer--!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what a weird shout!
Thanks, though!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lean on you with all my weight,
make sure you support me properly, okay?
